book.name: Luka
book.title: Bais ula mumuru la omirong Luka aime Iesu

content: Amirong Luka irio gas me ai Tiofilas
Aun migan tuang Tiofilas, Tinan, papaluaip ma teip la mavuomeng kilalap ma ga omirmeng gas ma mirier pagap la makosarong Morowa ga betmeng kabirana pa.

Omirmeng ties ga mameuluan tiesiap maiam miriro garip ma inamaniap mirie mila maionama tinan lake ga Iesu ga magimameng mirio pagap ma irap ma. Mirio inamaniap o ubi la baismeng ga magimameng mirio pagap ma irap ma. Mirio inamaniap o ubi o bais ula mumuru la man ovaikmeng uro gas pai.

Are ratmat ga man agatung ga tuga maset ureng na mirio tiesiap la betmeng kabirana pa. Are ratmat ga man ubirung a tara ila laklage, ga tuga maset maroping muap ma miriro tiesiap la uakap. Are titot, migana ila kani Tiofilas, man mamirtung it maset mirie tiesiap uakap minan la betmeng.
Makosartung gare rie, memani narung la onera maset urio ties la nosingmaialar o. Uriet la migat kan o.
Angelo la aulo Sekaraia o, Elisabet la eba avarangeieng madalak Ioanes

Tie, iro gas la teuara na tara orong Herot la uale bo mirier garip ma Iudaiap. Non miridai la unama bonim a Sekaraia. Irie la unama ana gar ang Abaisa. Kuala ang la urie ea ang Eron. Bonim o urie magabun la, Elisabet.
Morowa la legimaong la aliuluan tavuk ila puvui ga maliuluan mirier maimaiap ganam, mirie la ualam Morowa aun Moses ga tale kan limaning kiribas.
Ga lailiong ara pa tale kan limaning kulot. Memani, Elisabet la tale puoieng leba iaring gat kulot ba.
Urie, non tara miridaip a gar maiang Abaisa la okosarmeng ubi na luguan o lotu ga Sekaraia gat la ubiong.

Miridaip la ameuluan tavuk maiang ga sagumeng o satu meba maiabung aga ba ma leba ala tapma na kabin ila puari ang Morowa ga okosarang ubi o bais urie nekurupniliap la ila ira Sekaraia. Are tapmat ga ula uobu meba okosarang ubi o miridai ga ualabio bonat ula kukufieng ga irilio bo luaga ang Morowa.
Na irie tara papaluaip ma teip ga magaulap la nebolameng tapma lavie, ga man okosarmeng marik.
Pa Sekaraia la man unama na kabin ga man okosarong ubi, pa talet kagat ga agimaong non angelo ang Ila Kani la man dusong bo kilan ila lamige a luaga la mime maiabu bonat ula kukufieng ana.
Na tara Sekaraia la agimaong angelo, turupuaba ga mitara urau maset.
Pa aulo angelo gare ro, “Sekaraia, buat nurau. Morowa la upto ra marik nung. Gare rie ga magabun nung Elisabet leba avarangeieng kulot ila migana ga eba abopnala o bonim Ioanes.
Tubiat dalap nuo leba maiot maset ga eba tenaba, ga papot ma teip ga magaulap leba temeba aime leba betang.

Memani, eba aving bonim ula kakanu na irap a Ila Kakani Ga tala kan ume tapu o burunam a wain o non ba non burunam ula ngangasieng. Na tara la unama ga na karima o naga ang, Muranama Ila Babai leba dakang ana.
Ga eba marigiang dalap ma papot ma teip ga magaulap onim Israel, ga eba ina ameuluan Morowa Ila Kani maiang.

Ga are gat to, eba ake me Ila Kani a tavuk ga ngangas ang Elia. Ga eba marigiang dalap ma irap me maun lop maiam ga eba marigiang dalap ma inamaniap mila buat oguekmeg ties ga eba omela agat ula mumuru. Are ratmat ga eba marangaang teip ga magaulap ga eba urangameng me Ila Kani leba muong onang ga mirie.”

Urie, pareong Sekaraia ga amarikong angelo gare ro, “Are mani ga eba orera urogo ties leba migat ba o ga ameba mulinim? Memani, lairung ara ga kuala rung gat ga kualapikieng ara, tale gat puoieng leba avarangeieng kulot ba.”
Pa irie angelo la upulo ties ga ugama, “Turuo Gabariel la tume dus na irap a Morowa. Morowa kan la tosagaong ga muruo meba noralava ga talang urogo ties ula mumuru noun.

Tie, naptang! Tale kan nagannung iro ties tung, gare tie ga nanam nuo leba pamuieng ga eba tale puonang meba naramam tiesiap ba, puoieng ira irie tara leba ameba mulinim ira irie tatak kulot leba betang. Urogo ties tung leba ame ba mulinim na irie tara la avuoong ara Morowa.”
Na irie tara, teip ga magaulap la man uanmela lavie me Sekaraia, ga man agatmeng papot ga megama, “Man paga la betong ira a ga mitara laklage tara la man unama tapma na kabin ila puari?”
Tubiat muo lavie ga tale gat puoong meba tiesang me maun. Are ratmat ga amira la agimaong non ara paga tapma na kabin ila babai. Man tiesong it ga mirie mat kilalap a, pa nanam a la pamuieng.
Man unama ka Sekaraia na luguan o lotu puoieng ira irie tara la ituamu ubi ang. Tubiat ga ula bat lakuan ang.
Pa tubiat, Elisabet la giginam neip o, ga man ionamat na luguan puoieng ira ma muanam ma ulangip. Pareieng ga igama,
“Ila Kani la akosarong tavuk ila muri ira ruo titot. Ga uala iro kulot toun, meba oralieang mulinubap tung la tale kan tume tomuge tinan kabirana ma teip ga magaulap.”
Angelo la oulo Maria meba avarangeieng kulot Iesu
Urie, na lama gunamur ulang, Elisabet la giginam neip o, Morowa la asagaong angelo Gabariel me na non pianam ula kakanu na nap iang provins Galili, bonim o Nasaret.
Ula meba oalava non magabun ula kubebun bonim o Maria. Ira iang la oanain ira non migana la namo eba magieng ai, bonim a Iosep irie migana a gar ma eap am orong Devit.
Ula angelo Gabariel ga ula oup ga ugama ume, “Malina le ot na dalap nuo, kubebun. Morowa la mitara naong maset me nulam, ga unama ga nunuo.”
Ipto Maria urie ties ga turupiaba maset ga agatieng papot, “Man ties uro la are ro ‘la ula muru’? Memani ga toulo gare ro?”
Angelo la oit ara la turupiaba ga ugama, “Maria, buat nurau. Memani mitara tevurusong Morowa me nulam ga noiteong.
Eva, naptang, tubiat leba nomuge ba ga eba avarangenang kulot ba ila migana ga eba abopnala o, bonim Iesu.
Ga eba aving bonim ula kakanu ga teip ga magaulap leba meivang a Poi ang Morowa tatuan nakap migat. Ga Morowa la eba abung ga eba irie ba orong, ga eba are ba ea ang a Devit la irie orong.
Ga eba ualeng bo teip ga magaulap onim Israel, mirie garip am Iekop ga eba irie ba orong ga eba man ualeng mabuo mar mirier lap ganam.”
Maria la amarikieng angelo gare ro, “Eba betang iriro paga gare ba mani? Tale ka magirung ira migana ba meba duriang ga turuo ga giginam ba neip tuo.”

Pa upulo angelo ties ieng ga ugama, “Muranam Ila Babai leba obung na dalap nuo, ga ngangas ang Morowa onim nakap leba noialung. Gare tie ga irie kulot leba avarangenang tubiat, teip ga magaulap leba meivang ga memama ‘Irie Ila Babai, Poi ang Morowa.’

Narung la tuga onera Elisabet la ionama na gar nung. Tinan la mime megama kualapikieng ara ga tala kan mugo, pa titot la imaning ara kulot ila migana na karima o, ga gunamur ma ulangip iam la aipmeng ara.
Memani, Morowa la puoong meba makosarang mirier pagap ganam. Mirie la ugama eba makosarang ga betmeng migat.”
Ipto Maria urie ties, urie igama, “Turuo magabun it o ubi ang Ila Kani; Irie la eba okosarang ira ruo gare ba rie la nulo.” Urie, oulai angelo ga ula.
Maria la ila ogimaieng Elisabet
Urie, tubiat it kirat teiara Maria ga ila kakalait na non pianam ula kanu na nap iang Iudaia la ionama nakap bo kavilap.
Ga ila na luguan ang Sekaraia ga igama ‘kabirana’ me un Elisabet.
Na tara la ipto Elisabet ‘kabirana’ ieng Maria, pareong kulot ga terigiong na karima o, ga Muranam Ila Babai la obodakong Elisabet.
Ga kukupieng maranit ga igama, “Morowa la nogiginaraong kabirana ma non magaulap. Ga agiginaraong gat ira kulot na karima nuo.
Teivuo, turuot magabun agarit tiro. Memani, naga ang Ila Kani ruang la tonagieng ga muio meba togimaieng!
Na tara kiginam tuo la ipto ‘kabirana’ nung, kulot la unama na karima ruo la tevurusong ga man teritigiong.
Nagan tung ira Ila Kani leba okosarang gare rie la noulo. Gare tie la ualo ra uro ugiginara ula kakanu noun meba avarangenang poi ang.”
Sasang la iaro Maria ga avienieng Morowa
Maria la iaramo sasang ga igama:

content.text: “Dalap tuo la avienmeng Ila Kani.
“Ga muranama ruo la tevurusong me Morowa, la inagat tolagiong.

“Turuot magabun ang o ubi agarit, pa irie kan la man tonagiong ga man akosarong tavuk ila muri ira ruo, titot ga tubiat gat. Ga mirier teip ga magaulap leba memama, ‘Morowa la ualo ugiginara ula kakanu un Maria.’
“Memani, Morowa la amanim mirie ngangasiap, irie kan la akosarong paga ila kani ira ruo. Eva, bonim a la babau maset.
“Ume akosar tavuk o kadik ira ma teip ga magaulap la mime mepto ties ang ga omeuluan. Ga okosarong gat ira ma eap ga tatak lop maiam ga ila puoieng atatan makin.
“Irie la okosarong ubi ula kanu o ngangas ang kan. Ga madadoulaong inamaniap tapmat mirie la man miaviam bop ma me nakap.
“Iniam orongup mila mamaranim la mime tevienmeng kan pa mavuvuoong inamaniap la tale ame bonim, ga ualo bonim ula kanu maun.
“Mabodakong dalap ma inamaniap la mumaio ai, un tafa me parak, ga utmeng ma pagap mila mumurum. Pa inamaniap la ame papot pagap la mumaio ai, pareong ga madadoula ga melat agarit.
“Aagaulie migana ang o ubi, Israel ga oagatang kan kadik ang.
“Are tie la maulo eap buam, leba kadikang aime Abraham ga gar ang leba betmeng tubiat ga ila puoieng ma mirie lap ganam.”

content: Maria la ionama ga Elisabet puoieng ira ma naien ma ulangip, urie tubiat ga ina bat ila lakuan ieng Nasaret.
Elisabet la avarageieng tatak kulot Ioanes
Urie, tara la betong ara meba uvarangeieng Elisabet, avarangeieng kulot ila migana are angelo Gabariel la tiesong.
Ga mirie na urie pianam ga garip iam Elisabet la mepto urio bais ula mumuru me Ila Kani la okosarong kadik ula kakanu ubuo ga avarangeieng kulot. Ga mitara tevurusmeng ga Elisabet.
Na la lama gamin mumaio meba akasaumeng kulot. Namo maialang bonim ‘Sekaraia’ aun are bonim a mamo.
Pa igama naga ang kulot, “Karuk. Ugama angelo eba abopbuala o bonim Ioanes.”
Pa paremeng garip iam ga omelo Elisabet ga megama, “Tale mumuru. Karuk kan ma garip ba mim la memaning uriro bonim.”
Urie, namoe amarikmeng ira ang kulot, gare tie la man okosarmeng it ties ma kilalap ma la namo omaioping man bonim leba alang aun kulot.
Sekaraia la maulo a kilan a meba maiarang babam ba ga maialang aun. Urie maialo babam aun ga omirong, ‘Bonim Ioanes.’ Agimameng inamaniap irio paga ga mitara turupmaiaba maset.
Ga talet kagat, ga puoong bat Sekaraia meba ina tiesang ga avienang Morowa.
Ga mirier ganam na urie pianam maiong la merau kan maset ga mitara turupmaiaba. Ga bais ma mirio pagap la betieng, ga ila na mirier napup ga pialap la maionama bo kavilap na napup iam Iudaia.

Mirier teip ga magaulap la mepto urio bais ga mitara agatmeng na dalap ma. Ga man marikmeng gare ro, “Tubiat isik kulot leba betang gare ba man migana?” Memani, omait ara ngangas ang Ila Kani la ionama ga irie.
Sasang ang Sekaraia
Urie, pareong Muranama Ila Babai ga abodakong Sekaraia, ira ang Ioanes ga uaramo ties gare unuli ga ugama:

content.text: “Buaving bonim a Ila Kani, irie Morowa iang Israel. Memani, muo ra meba buagalie bubuo teip ga magaulap am, ga muo meba ina busauang.
“Na gar ang Devit migana o ubi ang, irie la irilia non migana ila ngangasong meba ina bulagiang gat.
“Gare tinan kan na nanamup ma unulip am mila babaum, irie la uaramo uriro ties.
“Eba ina bulagiang na kilalap ma karorap buam. Ga na kilalap
ma teip ga magaulap mila kiram dalap ma maset me bulam.
“Ga are gat to, ugama eba okosarang kadik me eap buam ga anagiang iriro mida ila babai la uala maun eap buam irie kan la akosarong.
“Eva, uala bukarima a aun ea buang Abraham.
“Namo eba buvugutara na kilalap ma karorap, ga eba buaring ubi ang ga tala kan burau.
“Ma mirie lap la man binim, eba man buaring ubi ang ma tavukup mila babaim ga ma tavukup mila puvuvum.
“Pa nunuo poi ruang, tubiat teip ga magaulap la eba nomeivang nunuo unuli ang Morowa tatuan nakap migat. Memani, eba nake me Ila Kani meba maranganang dalap ma teip ga magaulap:
“Eba masingnala teip ga magaulap a ga eba ameira, ga eba maralieang Ila Kani kirinimup maiam ga eba ina malagiang gat.
“Memani, Morowa buang la ume okosar kadik ira buo. Gare tie ga eba alang ileng onim na panbinim ga muong buun. Eba kana gare ba efan ila kani la ume muo togo lourup,
“Ga eba alang ileng maun teip ga magaulap mirie la man maionama na tavuk ila kire ga
kagarat ara meba meving. Eba ovuvutaling ninimiap buong na alang la ualo buun urie nunamap ula muru ga Morowa.”

content: Tubiat leba betang irio kulot ga kakani ba, ga betang muranama a ga mamarani ba. Urie eba onang na pianam la karuk ma inamaniap, puoieng ira irie tara leba betang la uakap na irap ma inamaniap onim Israel.
